asked.item: which n8n field to use for poll options
scheduling a LinkedIn poll for Monday via n8n

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that Blotato does not support LinkedIn poll publishing, including the n8n node, so there is no poll options field to use.

steps.text: Blotato does not support publishing LinkedIn polls yet, so there is no poll options field to use.
This includes the n8n node, which does not support poll publishing either.
To publish a LinkedIn poll today, create it directly in LinkedIn or use another tool that supports LinkedIn poll publishing.
